manufacturer.name: Nice
manufacturer.note: Italian gate, door and barrier automation manufacturer. It serves its instruction PDFs from one flat directory, sites/default/files/upload/manuals, named by document code - which makes that directory the single highest-value harvest target in this registry. Its professional-area download index is paginated and a search result surfaced page 71, so the manual set behind it runs to hundreds of documents; what is recorded here is a sample.

documents.title: ROBO600 Instructions and Warnings for Installation
documents.evidence: Manufacturer's own domain, and the search result title names ROBO600 explicitly. Document code read from the filename. Not fetched - egress blocked.

Not fetched - egress blocked.

documents.evidence: On niceforyou.com. The model code here is the document code, because neither the file name nor the search result named the product - only that it is for sliding gates. Whoever verifies this link should retitle the record from the document's cover. Not fetched - egress blocked.

documents.title: Nice instruction manual IDV0777A00EN
documents.evidence: On niceforyou.com. The search result gave no title or product for this document at all - only the URL. It is recorded by its document code alone so the file is not lost, and nothing about its product, type or scope is asserted. This is the weakest record in the library and is exactly what the review queue is for. Not fetched - egress blocked.
